findings.text: The README says source `9e3b4419` passed "all 323 model cases", but the retained record (`pr48-darwin-qualified.json`, `skipped: "1"`) shows 322 passed and one Tcl skip. Fix: write "322 passed and one Tcl skip of 323 model cases", as in the Linux paragraph and the status file.

The deadline section still says that 600 seconds is "approximately twice the measured 300.70-second macOS completion", but the new Darwin evidence shows a 484.735-second model suite, which leaves about 115 seconds of headroom. Fix: update the rationale in this section to name the 484.735-second observation and the headroom that remains under 600 seconds.
